properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: hash.js@1.1.3 ships alongside elliptic as the hashing toolbox for ECDSA sign/verify internals in the ethers/hardhat signing stack (SHA-1/SHA-2/RIPEMD-160 in its surface). Transitive devDependency (dev:true); SHA-1 exposure is Grover-only and used inside the EC library, not by application code directly.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: secp256k1 is the curve of every Ethereum transaction this Hardhat/ethers dev stack signs. The secp256k1@4.0.2 native addon and elliptic@6.5.3 (pure-JS) are transitive devDependencies (dev:true) of the hardhat/ethereum-waffle/ethereumjs toolchain, shipped into node_modules on npm install. Changeable here by upgrading the toolchain; the application never calls secp256k1 directly — it reaches it through ethers.js when deploying contracts.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: evp_bytestokey@1.0.3 is the OpenSSL EVP_BytesToKey port (single-round MD5 KDF) pulled in by crypto-browserify's browser polyfills of Node's crypto module — a transitive devDependency of the hardhat/ethereum-waffle build chain. The single-MD5-iteration KDF is a known weak practice; here it derives keys inside browserify-aes for the polyfill's own paths. Library surface shipped in node_modules; no direct call site in this repo's application code.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: create-ecdh@4.0.4 implements ECDH over elliptic (bn.js/elliptic ^6.5.3) as part of crypto-browserify 3.12.0's browser polyfill of Node's crypto module — a transitive devDependency of the hardhat/ethereum-waffle toolchain. Library surface shipped in node_modules; no ECDH call site exists in this repo's own code (it is not the Ethereum signing path, which is ECDSA).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: elliptic@6.5.3 is the pure-JS ECDSA implementation ethers.js 5.x uses to sign every Ethereum transaction this toolchain sends (secp256k1). This repo's own code triggers it indirectly through ethers.getContractFactory().deploy() (scripts/deploy.ts, test/counter.ts). 6.5.3 is the post-2020 signature-malleability fix release. Transitive devDependency of hardhat/ethereum-waffle; changeable by upgrading the toolchain.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: X25519 (crypto_scalarmult) ships via tweetnacl@1.0.3, required by eth-sig-util@2.5.4 (Ethereum signed-message encrypt/decrypt, lines 4056-4058) in the ethereum-waffle/hardhat dev chain. Library surface shipped in node_modules; no X25519 call site in this repo's own code. Shor-vulnerable if ever used, but nothing in the application negotiates keys with it.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Keccak-256 is Ethereum's workhorse hash (address derivation, transaction and ABI hashing), pulled in by every @ethersproject package and ethereumjs library of the dev toolchain. Grover-only quantum impact, not migration-urgent. Changeable by upgrading the toolchain; the application reaches it through ethers.js rather than calling js-sha3 itself.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: scrypt is the password KDF ethers.js uses for JSON keystore (Web3 Secret Storage) files: scrypt-js@3.0.1 is the @ethersproject keystore dependency, scrypt-js@2.0.4 an older pin under ethereumjs, scryptsy@1.2.1 optional for ganache. Dev toolchain only (dev:true); this repo's own code never creates or decrypts a keystore. Memory-hard KDF, no direct quantum concern.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: tweetnacl's secretbox (XSalsa20-Poly1305) and one-shot auth via tweetnacl@1.0.3, required by eth-sig-util@2.5.4 in the ethereum-waffle/hardhat dev chain (used for its encryptSafely/decryptSafely signed-message encryption). Symmetric authenticated encryption — PQ impact limited to Grover key-search halving, which is why it rates A+. Library surface only; no application call site.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: elliptic is the EC workhorse of the entire Ethereum dev stack: ECDSA secp256k1 signing (via ethers 5.x), ECDH (via create-ecdh), required by eth-lib, ethereumjs-util, secp256k1@4.0.2's JS fallback and crypto-browserify. It is the code that actually signs this project's Ethereum transactions. Transitive devDependency (dev:true); changeable by upgrading the toolchain. Distinct from ALG-710f61f0 (the ECDSA algorithm it provides) — kept as the library entry.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: pbkdf2@3.x is the browser polyfill of Node's crypto.pbkdf2 under crypto-browserify (and a KDF option for legacy Ethereum keystores in ethereumjs) — a transitive devDependency of the hardhat/ethereum-waffle toolchain. Library surface shipped in node_modules; no application call site in this repo.
